1.title: What We Know About Lindsay Clancy’s Trial for the Deaths of Her Children
1.summary: The case in Massachusetts has revived a debate about postpartum psychosis. The trial starts Monday.

2.title: Jeffries Kicks Off Midterm Sprint With Economic Pitch
2.summary: Representative Hakeem Jeffries, the New York Democrat and minority leader, focused relentlessly on affordability in a swing district.

3.title: At Least 3 Killed in Shooting at Food Festival in Seattle
3.summary: Four others were injured near the city’s Space Needle, the authorities said. The police took a suspect into custody and were searching for another.

4.title: Wildfires Live Updates: Spain and France Fight to Contain Blazes as Extreme Heat Threatens New Fires
4.summary: Firefighters in eastern Spain were working to hold back a worsening wildfire on Monday. The crisis has forced hundreds of thousands to evacuate in central Spain and southwest France.

5.title: Merz Criticizes Terrorism Laws After Deadly Berlin Pride Attack
5.summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz of Germany called for tighter monitoring after the authorities said the suspect in the assault had tried to join ISIS and was released from detention in May.

6.title: How the Iran-Backed Houthis Cornered Saudi Arabia Into a New Conflict
6.summary: The Iran-backed Houthi militia in Yemen has seized on a vulnerable moment for neighboring Saudi Arabia, which does not want another war. The group hopes to force political concessions in Yemen that could give it more authority and more access to resources.
